bio: The globally renowned Beefbar concept, which originated in Monte Carlo, has now arrived in St Moritz, at the luxurious Grace La Margna hotel. Open in the evenings, this restaurant has an elegant interior with a DJ providing the perfect musical backdrop. The waitstaff are courteous and professional. The international menu is dominated by premium charcoal-grilled meat cuts, but select fish and vegetables also feature in seasonal dishes. The impressive wine list is complemented by a fantastic cocktail menu....
